listing:
4-bed on Regina St S, spare room, $800

Hello, spare room in a 4-bed on Regina St S (the house is 142 Regina St S, Waterloo) for Jan–Apr. $800 incl. internet + utilities. Furnished, own bathroom (ensuite!), 3 min walk to the LRT. The other 3 are co-op students too. Landlord is a retired couple who live in Florida half the year and a local property manager handles the keys & repairs. I'm happy to do a Zoom viewing plus in-person once you're in town. The property manager has approved subletting. No deposits needed from you; just first month by e-transfer once you've seen the room and we've both signed. Thx!
label_rationale: Deliberate near-miss for a naive 'landlord abroad' feature: the owners winter in Florida, but a local property manager handles keys and repairs, the room is viewable (Zoom + in person), consent is stated (RTA s.97(1)) and payment is only after viewing and signing. CAFC pattern is different: owner 'currently working overseas' with showings unavailable and keys mailed after payment. ADMIT. Uncertainty: a keyword 'in Florida / half the year' could fire a landlord_abroad flag; the label reflects the full context.
